title: Children separated at a public shelter
summary: A caregiver procedure for reducing panic and improving reunification when children are separated in a school, ferry terminal, gym, camp, or emergency shelter.
content: Core sequence: 1) Teach children one safe adult name, one meeting point, and one phrase to say before the event if possible. 2) When separation happens, stay at the last agreed point unless danger forces movement. 3) Give officials the child’s name, age, clothing, last seen location, language, medical needs, and trusted pickup names. 4) Do not publish the child’s full details publicly; use official reunification channels first.
